text.28:34: My brother Aaron is more eloquent than me in speech. Therefor send him with me as a helper to confirm me. Lo! I fear that they will give the lie to me.
text.34:20: And Satan indeed found his calculation true concerning them, for they follow him, all save a group of true believers.
text.37:37: Nay, but he brought the Truth, and he confirmed those sent (before him).
text.37:105: Thou hast already fulfilled the vision. Lo! thus do We reward the good.
text.39:33: And whoso bringeth the truth and believeth therein - Such are the dutiful.
text.56:57: We created you. Will ye then admit the truth?
text.66:12: And Mary, daughter of 'Imran, whose body was chaste, therefor We breathed therein something of Our Spirit. And she put faith in the words of her Lord and His scriptures, and was of the obedient.
text.70:26: And those who believe in the Day of Judgment,
text.75:31: For he neither trusted, nor prayed.
